definitions.full: H8412. Tadmor or Tammor תַּדְמֹר proper name, of a location built by Solomon , according to 1Kin 9:18 Qr = 2Chr 8:8 ; Tadmor = Palmyra (RS Ency. Brit. (9) PALMYBA Mommsen Röm. Geschichte. see 423, compare Lag BN 125 ); but read in both places תָּמָר Th RS l.c. Mommsen l.c. Kmp Benz Kit Bur Reckend ZMG xiii (1888), 402 Lag l.c. GASm Geogr, 270, N. 2; 580, N. 2 ; see II. תָּמָר .
